violation_type.title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)
violation_type.short_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary
violation_type.typical_finding: Food expired was found inside the refrigerator and in the storage cabinet.

finding_variants.text: Food expired was found inside the refrigerator and in the storage cabinet.

Single-use cups were being reused through out the day to provide children drinking water in the afterschool room. The cups were labeled with each child's name.         Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as the single-use cups were disposed.
Food observed stored in fridge was uncovered.
There are gnats in general classrooms and in the kitchen there was a jar of grease.

Children have been served burnt biscuits, uncooked oatmeal and bananas that contained growing mold on the stem.  Milk is being stored in classroom mini refrigerators resulting in the milk freezing.  Frozen fruit is not being fully thawed before serving to children.
Expired food items were observed in the kitchen including tortillas and canned food.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider removed the food items from the operation.
